HediffDef.label: nanite EMP receiver
HediffDef.description: Internal WNG tracker that allows EMP damage to disrupt a human-shaped nanite body.

HediffDef.label: nanite coordination disruption
HediffDef.description: EMP has temporarily collapsed the body's distributed nanite coordination. Accelerated healing and missing-part reconstruction pause until the network recovers.

HediffDef.label: sovereign neural lattice
HediffDef.description: An implanted command lattice that grants bounded direct authority over base/block WNG Replicators. It does not confer Replicator Queen identity or her passive whole-swarm coordination.
